name: batch14
rows: futuristic railgun rifle with exactly the shape of the reference: a dark grey-black angular folding stock with a cut-out, a flat receiver with a small optic on top, a pistol grip, a long open barrel shroud with two parallel rails and a heavy block at the muzzle. Add glowing parts so it reads as a railgun: thin bright cyan-blue energy lines running along the top and bottom rails of the barrel shroud, a glowing blue core window in the receiver, glowing blue slits in the muzzle block and a faint blue glow line on the stock. Everything else stays dark grey-black like the reference.
